connector.name: OpenAI Ads MCP by trakkr-aisearch
connector.registryDescription: OpenAI Ads MCP for ChatGPT Ads campaigns, creatives, audiences, insights, and conversions.
connector.summary: Hosted at openai-ads-mcp.trakkr.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package openai-ads-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the trakkr-aisearch account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-OpenAI-Ads-API-Key
headers.description: OpenAI Ads API key from Ads Manager. Required only for Ads API tool calls; discovery, initialize, and tools/list work without it.

env.name: OPENAI_ADS_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI Ads API key from Ads Manager. Scoped to one ad account.

env.name: OPENAI_ADS_MCP_READONLY
env.description: Set to 1 for first connection so write tools are hidden.

env.name: OPENAI_ADS_BUDGET_CEILING_USD
env.description: Optional budget guard for spend-changing tools. Defaults to 100.
